Kuvitus: korkeushyppy ulkostadionilla ke: Illustration: a high jump at an outdoor stadium on a summer day. In the middle the jumper arches backwards over the bar, and under the bar is a thick blue landing mat. A dashed line shows the path of the jumper, curving over the bar and down onto the mat. In the background are the stands and the running track, and next to the mat there is grass.
Kaavakuva, nuolet mittakaavassa: kolme p: Diagram with arrows to scale: three balls on an x-axis whose positive direction is to the right. At the top a 0.45 kilogram football moves to the right at 20 metres per second: a long blue velocity arrow and a purple momentum arrow, momentum 9.0 kilogram metres per second. In the middle a 6.0 kilogram bowling ball moves to the right at 1.5 metres per second: a very short velocity arrow but a momentum arrow as long as the football's, since the momentum is the same 9.0. At the bottom the football moves to the left at 10 metres per second: the arrows point to the left, and the momentum is minus 4.5 kilogram metres per second.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa, simulaation malli: Graph to scale, model values of the simulation: the force F of the bumper in newtons as a function of time when a 1.0 kilogram cart stops from a velocity of 2.0 metres per second. Hard bumper: the force rises to 80 newtons and the collision lasts 0.039 seconds, a narrow and tall curve. Soft bumper: the force rises to only 20 newtons, but the collision lasts 0.157 seconds, a low and wide curve. The areas under both curves are shaded, and they are equal, 2.0 newton seconds.
Kaavakuva, ei lukuarvoja: törmäyksen aik: Diagram, no numerical values: during a collision the force F grows from zero to its greatest value and falls back to zero during the time interval Delta t. The area under the curve is the impulse I. A rectangle drawn with dashed lines, whose height is the average force F_avg and whose width is Delta t, has the same area as the region under the curve.
Kaavakuva, nuolet mittakaavassa. Vasemma: Diagram, arrows to scale. On the left the ball before and after the collision: before the collision the ball moves to the right towards the wall and its momentum p0 points to the right; afterwards the ball moves just as fast to the left and its momentum p points to the left. On the right the change in momentum: p and minus p0 placed one after the other form the arrow Delta p, which is twice as long as p0 and points to the left. At the bottom the impulse I of the force of the wall, as long as Delta p and in the same direction.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: vaakasuora voima,: Graph to scale: the horizontal force pushing a sled as a function of time. The force grows steadily from zero to 60 newtons in 0.20 seconds, stays at 60 newtons until 0.80 seconds and falls steadily to zero at 1.00 seconds. On the horizontal axis time 0–1.2 seconds at intervals of 0.2 seconds, on the vertical axis force 0–80 newtons at intervals of 20 newtons.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: voima, jolla jalk: Graph to scale: the force with which a foot kicks a ball as a function of time in milliseconds. The force grows steadily from zero to 900 newtons in 6 milliseconds and falls steadily to zero at 12 milliseconds. On the horizontal axis time 0–14 milliseconds at intervals of 2 milliseconds, on the vertical axis force 0–1000 newtons in squares of 100 newtons, numbers at intervals of 200 newtons.
